hero.title:
web
development
hero.description: We craft high-performance, bespoke websites and scalable web applications engineered to elevate your brand. From fluid interactive animations to robust full-stack engineering and search optimization, we transform complex technical challenges into seamless digital experiences that captivate modern audiences, accelerate user engagement, and drive measurable, sustainable commercial growth for your company.

featured.heading: What we build under web development
featured.subheading: Four things we do every week. Scroll sideways through them.

items.title: Bespoke websites
items.text: Designed from a blank page around your brand, never a template.

items.title: Web applications
items.text: Dashboards, portals and tools that stay fast as your users grow.

items.title: Interactive animation
items.text: Scroll, motion and micro-interactions that guide people forward.

items.title: Search optimization
items.text: Clean markup and quick pages that search engines reward.

content.quote: A website is the first conversation you have with a customer. We make sure it is fast, memorable and impossible to scroll past without feeling something.

items.title: Your site loads slowly
items.text: Visitors leave before the first screen finishes painting.

items.title: It looks like everyone else
items.text: A recycled template makes your brand easy to forget.

items.title: It breaks on phones
items.text: Most of your traffic arrives on a small screen and gets a bad one.

items.title: Nobody can find it
items.text: Good work stays hidden when search engines can't read it.

solution.heading: So we fix them at the root.
solution.subheading: Each problem above has a matching answer in how we plan, design and build.

items.title: Performance built in from day one
items.text: Optimized images, lean code and server rendering keep every page quick on any connection.

items.title: A design made only for you
items.text: We start from your story and your audience, then build the interface and motion around it.

items.title: Designed for the smallest screen first
items.text: Every layout is tested on real devices before it reaches a laptop.

items.title: Search-ready structure
items.text: Semantic markup, fast pages and clear metadata give you a solid base to rank from.

paragraphs.heading: Content and SEO that works together

items.title: Built to be found
items.text: A beautiful website only works if people can find it. We plan keywords, page structure and internal links before design begins, so every page has a clear job and a clear audience searching for it.

items.title: Content that earns attention
items.text: Search engines reward pages that answer real questions. We write and structure content around what your customers actually ask, in plain language, with headings and summaries that make answers easy to scan.

items.title: Speed is a ranking signal
items.text: Slow pages lose visitors and rankings. We compress media, split code and render on the server, aiming for strong Core Web Vitals so your site feels instant on both fast and slow connections.

items.title: Structure search engines can read
items.text: Clean semantic HTML, descriptive metadata, structured data and sensible URLs help crawlers understand each page. It also makes your site more accessible to people using assistive technology.

items.title: Mobile-first, always
items.text: Most searches now happen on phones, and search engines index the mobile version first. Every layout we build is designed and tested on small screens before it is scaled up to desktop.

items.title: Measured, then improved
items.text: Launch is the start of the work. We set up analytics and search tracking, watch what visitors do, and refine pages over time so traffic and enquiries keep growing instead of flattening out.

faq.heading: Questions we hear a lot
faq.subheading: Don't see yours? Tell us about your project and we'll answer it directly.

items.q: How long does a web development project take?
items.a: A focused marketing site usually takes three to five weeks. Larger web applications run eight to sixteen weeks, depending on features and integrations. You get a timeline before we start.

items.q: What technologies do you use?
items.a: We build with Next.js and React, animate with GSAP, and pair them with the backend and database that suit your product. We pick tools for the job, not for trends.

items.q: Will my website work well on mobile?
items.a: Yes. We design and test for phones and tablets first, then scale up to desktop.

items.q: Do you handle SEO and performance?
items.a: Both are part of every build: clean structure, optimized media, metadata and speed checks before launch.

items.q: Can you redesign or extend my existing site?
items.a: Yes. We can refresh the design, rebuild it on a faster stack, or add new features to what you already have.

items.q: What happens after launch?
items.a: We stay on for support and improvements. You can choose a maintenance plan or hand off with full documentation.

metadata.title: App Development | Bugsmoker
metadata.description: High-performance iOS and Android mobile apps engineered for fluid 60fps gestures, offline resilience, and seamless scalability.

hero.title:
app
development
hero.description: We build high-performance mobile applications that users love keeping on their home screens. From instant touch responsiveness and offline-first data synchronization to seamless biometric authentication and frictionless checkout flows, our mobile engineers turn ambitious app concepts into buttery-smooth native experiences across iOS and Android.

featured.heading: What we build under app development
featured.subheading: Native and cross-platform mobile products built for retention. Scroll sideways.

items.title: iOS & Android Apps
items.text: Cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter and React Native that feel pure native.

items.title: Offline-First Sync
items.text: Local caching and background sync engines so the app works anywhere without signal.

items.title: Micro-Interactions & Haptics
items.text: Tactile feedback, custom spring physics, and fluid gestures that make interactions physical.

items.title: App Store Launch & ASO
items.text: End-to-end guidance through Apple and Google submission, review policies, and rankings.

content.quote: An app lives directly in your customer's pocket. It must launch in a heartbeat, respect battery life, and make every single tap feel completely effortless.

problem.heading: Most mobile apps get deleted within days.

items.title: Sluggish stutter and jank
items.text: Dropped animation frames and unresponsive buttons immediately drive users away.

items.title: Battery and cellular drain
items.text: Unoptimized polling, background runaway threads, and bloated asset bundles drain phones quickly.

items.title: App store rejection loops
items.text: Opaque guideline rejections, missing privacy declarations, and metadata mistakes delay launch for months.

items.title: Broken offline experience
items.text: The app freezes or throws unhandled error dialogues the second users lose Wi-Fi or cellular reception.

solution.heading: Engineered for high retention.
solution.subheading: We design and build mobile apps that are resilient, tactile, and deeply integrated with hardware.

items.title: 60 FPS native rendering pipelines
items.text: We offload expensive calculations from the UI thread so transitions and gestures remain locked at silky 60fps.

items.title: Smart delta sync and silent push
items.text: We fetch only differential data changes and coordinate background jobs when the device is idle or charging.

items.title: Strict compliance by design
items.text: We audit store guidelines, accessibility criteria, and privacy manifests before submitting the very first release build.

items.title: Local SQLite caching with offline queue
items.text: Users can browse and take actions offline; mutations persist locally and reconcile seamlessly upon reconnection.

paragraphs.heading: Mobile craft from blueprint to store release

items.title: Modular clean architecture
items.text: We decouple business logic, state management, and visual components into clean, testable layers. This ensures features can be added, refactored, or swapped without triggering unintended regressions across the app.

items.title: Gestures tuned to physics
items.text: Touch screens require instant sensory confirmation. We tune interactive drag cards, velocity-based spring dismissals, and subtle haptics so every touch feels satisfyingly tangible and native to the platform.

items.title: Hardware security and biometrics
items.text: We leverage Apple's Secure Enclave and Android Keystore for cryptographic key storage, paired with biometric Face ID and fingerprint authentication to safeguard personal user data against device interception.

items.title: Automated CI/CD build distribution
items.text: Every pull request triggers automated unit testing and end-to-end device simulations, generating signed staging builds dispatched directly to your team's TestFlight and Google Play Internal testing groups.

items.title: Deep platform hardware integration
items.text: From dynamic lock-screen widgets and interactive rich push notifications to background Bluetooth beacons and camera processing, we utilize the full hardware capabilities of modern smartphones.

items.title: Real-time telemetry and APM
items.text: Detailed crash tracking, breadcrumb telemetry, and user journey analytics allow our engineers to identify and resolve edge-case bugs and dropped frames before users ever report a support ticket.

faq.heading: Questions about mobile apps
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about building, publishing, and maintaining mobile software.

items.q: Do you build native apps or cross-platform apps?
items.a: We build primarily with Flutter and React Native because they deliver native 60fps performance from a single codebase, saving you up to 40% in cost. When specialized hardware demands it, we write native Swift or Kotlin modules.

items.q: How do you handle App Store and Google Play approvals?
items.a: We handle the entire submission journey: developer account setup, bundle identifiers, privacy manifests, rating certificates, review submissions, and direct resolution of Apple or Google feedback.

items.q: Can our app function when users lose internet?
items.a: Yes. We design with an offline-first architecture using local SQLite or Realm databases that queue updates and seamlessly reconcile state when connectivity returns.

items.q: How long does it take to develop a custom app?
items.a: A refined MVP typically takes six to ten weeks from design to store submission. Complex enterprise applications with custom backend integrations typically run twelve to twenty weeks.

items.q: Can you connect the app to our existing web platform or API?
items.a: Absolutely. We integrate with RESTful services, GraphQL endpoints, Supabase, Firebase, and existing bespoke legacy ERP or CRM backends.

items.q: Who owns the source code and app store accounts?
items.a: You retain 100% full intellectual property and source code ownership, and all apps are published under your company's own official Apple and Google developer accounts.

From complex data processing pipelines and distributed architectures to custom internal tooling and secure third-party integrations, we turn convoluted business workflows into dependable, high-efficiency software engines.

featured.subheading: Scalable backends, enterprise systems, and custom automation engines. Scroll sideways.

items.title: Custom Enterprise SaaS

items.title: Distributed Cloud APIs

items.title: Workflow Automation Engines

items.title: Legacy Modernization

content.quote: Great software does not just solve a problem today; it creates an architectural foundation that empowers your business to scale ten times larger without breaking.

problem.heading: Spaghetti code and brittle architectures hold companies back.

items.title: Technical debt bottlenecks
items.text: Shipping a simple feature takes weeks because code is tangled, unverified, and terrifying to touch.

items.title: Database crashes under load
items.text: Unindexed queries, memory leaks, and connection limits freeze servers during peak business hours.

items.title: Security and compliance vulnerabilities
items.text: Outdated packages, unencrypted secrets, and flawed authorization logic leave critical customer data exposed.

items.title: Siloed data and manual work
items.text: Employees spend hours copying CSVs and manually coordinating disconnected third-party software tools.

solution.heading: Engineered for scale, speed, and safety.
solution.subheading: We build clean, test-driven systems that your engineers love maintaining and your business can rely on.

items.title: Domain-driven modular code
items.text: Strict domain boundaries, automated test suites, and clean documentation make ongoing feature evolution safe and fast.

items.title: High-efficiency query and cache design
items.text: Connection pooling, Redis caching layers, and optimized database indexes allow backends to effortlessly swallow traffic spikes.

items.title: Zero-trust architecture and audit logs
items.text: Granular role-based access control, automated vulnerability scanning, encrypted data-at-rest, and complete audit trails.

items.title: Event-driven asynchronous pipelines
items.text: Message queues coordinate real-time data flow between your payment gateways, CRM, inventory, and analytics systems.

paragraphs.heading: Engineering standards built for enterprise scale

items.title: Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
items.text: We model your software around real-world business domains. By speaking the same ubiquitous language as your operations team, we eliminate misunderstandings and ensure code reflects actual operational workflows.

items.title: Test-driven reliability
items.text: Every mission-critical transaction, calculation, and API call is covered by automated regression suites. Code is continuously verified so updates deploy to production without fear of downtime.

items.title: Resilient distributed architecture
items.text: We embrace fault tolerance by designing microservices with circuit breakers, retry queues, and graceful degradation so a failure in one service never brings down your entire company.

items.title: API first and typed contracts
items.text: Whether building internal microservices or public developer APIs, we deliver type-safe contracts with OpenAPI and TypeScript, providing self-documenting endpoints that reduce team friction.

items.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
items.text: We codify your servers, containers, networks, and databases using Terraform and Docker. Environments are reproducible in minutes with zero configuration drift.

items.title: Observability and deep telemetry
items.text: Structured JSON logs, distributed request tracing, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation give you deep visibility into every millisecond of system execution across your entire stack.

faq.heading: Questions about software development
faq.subheading: Answers about our architecture, engineering practices, and delivery process.

items.q: What programming languages and stacks do you specialize in?
items.a: We build robust systems using Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust on the backend, paired with PostgreSQL, Redis, and message queues on AWS, GCP, or bare-metal Kubernetes.

items.q: Can you modernize our existing legacy monolithic software?
items.a: Yes. We employ the Strangler Fig pattern to progressively migrate critical services off legacy systems into clean, modern architectures without halting your daily business operations.

items.q: How do you ensure data security and compliance?
items.a: We enforce SOC2 and GDPR best practices: end-to-end data encryption, strict role-based access control (RBAC), sanitized database inputs, and regular automated penetration testing.

items.q: How are code changes tested and deployed?
items.a: We set up automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Every change passes linting, unit tests, integration tests, and security scans before hitting zero-downtime deployment stages.

items.q: Can you integrate with our third-party ERP, CRM, and payment gateways?
items.a: Yes. We regularly build custom connectors for Stripe, Salesforce, SAP, QuickBooks, Shopify, HubSpot, and bespoke legacy internal databases.

items.q: What kind of ongoing support do you offer for custom software?
items.a: We offer dedicated SLA support tiers providing 24/7 incident response, scheduled security patching, database optimization, and continuous feature roadmapping.

problem.heading: Servers crash when you least expect them to.

items.title: Unnoticed middle-of-the-night outages
items.text: Your site goes down for hours before anyone notices, bleeding revenue and hurting your reputation.

items.title: Vulnerable unpatched plugins

solution.heading: Proactive engineering, zero excuses.

items.title: Real-time telemetry and pager rotation
items.text: Global heartbeat monitors trigger immediate escalation to our on-call engineers the moment an anomaly is detected.

items.title: Automated patching and WAF firewalls

items.title: Direct communication with real engineers

paragraphs.heading: Infrastructure built for complete peace of mind

items.title: Multi-region edge architecture
items.text: We serve your static assets and dynamic queries from global edge nodes closest to your users, cutting latency down to milliseconds regardless of whether your customer is in London, New York, or Tokyo.

items.title: Automated rollback and staging
items.text: Every update is deployed to a preview staging environment first. If a production deployment fails health checks, our automated rollback systems revert to the last stable build instantly with zero downtime.

items.title: Immutable off-site backups
items.text: We retain encrypted snapshots across geographically isolated AWS S3 and GCP storage buckets with write-once-read-many (WORM) policies that protect your database against ransomware attacks.

items.title: Proactive security audits
items.text: Our DevOps team routinely scans SSL certificates, DNS health, domain expiration dates, dependency vulnerability alerts, and server access logs to resolve risks before they materialize.

items.title: Database tuning and pruning
items.text: Over time, databases accumulate dead tuples and fragmentation. We perform weekly routine query profiling, index rebalancing, and vacuuming to ensure query speeds stay lightning fast.

items.title: Dedicated SLA guarantees
items.text: We put our money where our mouth is. Our enterprise service level agreements commit to 99.99% network uptime and guaranteed response windows backed by financial credits.

faq.heading: Frequently asked hosting & support questions
faq.subheading: Clear answers about how we manage your infrastructure and assist your team.

items.q: What cloud providers do you host our systems on?
items.a: We configure and manage infrastructure across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), DigitalOcean, and Vercel, matching the exact compliance and performance requirements of your workload.

items.q: How quickly do you respond when something goes wrong?
items.a: For critical production outages, our on-call team responds in under 15 minutes 24/7/365. For standard support requests and non-urgent inquiries, we respond within two hours during business hours.

items.q: Can you migrate our existing website or software to your hosting?
items.a: Yes. We handle end-to-end migrations including database exports, asset transfers, DNS cutover, and SSL certificate issuance with zero downtime for your active users.

items.q: How often are backups taken and where are they stored?
items.a: We perform automated hourly incremental database backups and daily full server snapshots, encrypted with AES-256 and stored offsite in multi-region cold storage.

items.q: Do we get access to our server and hosting accounts?
items.a: Yes. You maintain full administrative ownership and access credentials. We operate with least-privilege delegation and never lock clients out of their own assets.

items.q: What does your monthly tech support cover?
items.a: Our monthly support plans cover software updates, security patch installations, uptime monitoring, bug fixes, performance tuning, DNS and email troubleshooting, and ongoing technical advisory.
